title: I forgot my password
steps: Go to the company login page and click "Forgot password".
Enter your work email address and check your inbox for a reset link.
If you don't receive the email within 5 minutes, check your Spam folder.
Still stuck? Use the 'Request Help' form and select 'Password Reset' - IT will handle it manually.

title: My account is locked out
steps: Accounts lock automatically after 5 failed login attempts, for 30 minutes.
Wait 30 minutes and try again with your correct password.
If you're sure your password is correct and it's still locked, submit a 'Password Reset' request - this usually means the account needs to be manually unlocked.

title: VPN won't connect
steps: Confirm you have an active internet connection outside the VPN first.
Restart the VPN client application completely (not just disconnect/reconnect).
Check that your VPN client shows the correct server address for your region.
If the issue persists, restart your computer - this resolves most stuck VPN sessions.
Still failing? Submit a 'Network Issue' request with the exact error message you're seeing.

title: Wi-Fi keeps disconnecting
steps: Forget the Wi-Fi network on your device and reconnect from scratch.
Move closer to the nearest access point if you're in a conference room or far corner.
Update your laptop's Wi-Fi driver if it hasn't been updated in a while.
If multiple people nearby are also affected, it's likely an access point issue - report it.

title: Outlook is not syncing new emails
steps: Check the connection status icon in the bottom status bar of Outlook.
Go to Send/Receive > Update Folder to force a manual sync.
Restart Outlook completely.
If it's still not syncing, check outlook.office.com in a browser - if email is there, it's a client-side sync issue, not a server issue.

title: Can't access a shared Teams/SharePoint file
steps: Confirm you're logged in with your work account, not a personal Microsoft account.
Ask the file owner to confirm you're on the share/permission list.
Try opening the link in a private/incognito browser window to rule out a cached login issue.
If permissions look correct but access still fails, submit an 'Access Request' with the file link.

title: Laptop running very slow
steps: Restart the laptop - this alone fixes the majority of slowdowns caused by memory leaks.
Check Task Manager (Ctrl+Shift+Esc) for any single application using unusually high CPU or memory.
Make sure Windows Update isn't installing updates in the background.
If it's consistently slow even after a restart, submit a hardware request - it may need a RAM upgrade or a disk health check.

title: Can't print to the office printer
steps: Confirm the printer shows as 'Online' in Windows Settings > Printers & Scanners.
Try printing a test page directly from Windows to isolate the issue from the specific app.
Restart the Print Spooler service (or ask IT to) if jobs are stuck in the queue.
If the printer is offline for everyone, it's likely a network/hardware issue - report it as a general outage.
